title: FileOperationFailed
description: Result: an expected, non-security business failure for a read/list/delete command against watch_dir (Decision #23, Design.md §13) — e.g. the target doesn't exist. Published in reply to the triggering *Requested command; eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's eventId. Deliberately NOT used for path-traversal or malformed-payload rejections — those stay a silent ack+log (Decision #22's posture), so a caller gets neither confirmation nor denial of what's really on disk for anything security-relevant. write has no equivalent failure case: FileWriteRequested auto-creates a missing file (Decision #19), so 'not found' never applies to it.

path.description: The path the failing command targeted.

reason.description: not_found: the target doesn't exist (read/list/delete). not_a_directory: a list target exists but is a file, not a directory.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the failure was observed.
